hooks.name: Culture guardrails review
hooks.description: When cultural content changes, reminds the agent to re-check sourcing and framing before continuing.

action.prompt: Cultural content was just edited. Before continuing, re-check the changed text: every card keeps an institution/title/URL source; folklore is labelled as folklore, not history; the Samhain 'Celtic new year' claim stays described as disputed; Halloween is not conflated with Dia de Muertos; candy, prices and unlock thresholds are described as original game mechanics. Report any problem instead of silently rewriting the source text.
